items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: You had Ralph here at the college and he was an outstanding piano player, really great.

ctx.x: Not like a Hamilton professor. Gee. And were you buying 78s?

78s yeah. Then I went to the LPs which I loved, and I loved the 45s. I still have a lot of 45s and I still have a lot of LPs which I play on the show because they haven’t come out on CD. There are some wonderful things. Some of the Ralph Sutton things are priceless. You had Ralph here at the college and he was an outstanding piano player, really great.

He sure was. Yeah, I know you mentioned that the other day on your show that you played something by him that wasn’t out, hadn’t been reissued yet. Do you — let’s talk about “The Sound of Jazz” for a bit. Do you listen first to everything you play?
